title: Hook a hanging travel scale onto a bag and hold it steady until the weight locks
instruction: Weigh the blue travel bag with the hanging scale. Hook it by the carry handle, lift the bag clear, and wait until the weight locks on the display. Lower the bag gently onto the bench. Return the unloaded scale to its peg with the reading still locked.
context: Before packing or traveling, a hanging luggage scale reads the loaded bag through the handle. The hook must carry the whole bag, and the suspended load has to settle for the lock reading. Leaning it on the bench or steadying it by hand alters the load. Once the display locks, the bag can be lowered under control.
setup: Station bench, cm from the center of the two arm bases. The blue zippered travel bag (23 × 18 × 11 cm, 642 g packed) rests at x 30.2, y 5.7, hinged D handle folded toward the robot's left. A vertical handheld scale with an open metal hook starts powered on, zeroed and in lock mode, hanging from an Ø8 mm peg at x 35.4 and z 27.6 cm, scale body centered at y −14.2. The peg projects 83 mm from the upright toward the bag, ending at y −13.5 cm. Both arms start at ready.
scoring: 0.25 when the hook alone supports the bag at least 25 mm clear of the bench and the hands no longer contact the bag. 0.6 once the locked reading is within 85 g of 642 g. 1.0 after lowering the bag onto the bench, the unloaded scale back on its peg with the locked reading, both released and the bag still for 1 s. A drop after lifting gives 0. Use a close video of the clearance and locked display, with a ruler for clearance and a reference scale to set the packed mass before the trial.
reset_notes: Put the packed bag at its marked orientation, fold the handle back down and return the handheld scale to the peg. Select lock mode and zero the empty scale before every attempt.
fidelity: The body, hook, handle and bag are rigid pieces with gravity and real contacts. A spring slide in the scale measures load. When the bag is hanging and the load is stable, the display retains the median reading for the rest of the trial. Flexible webbing, wall-clock electronics and viscous damping of a real instrument are approximated.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 in 1,200 steps. Scripted demo: 1.0 in 464 steps with a locked 0.64 kg reading. Lifting then lowering without waiting: 0.25, no locked reading.
